# Light › Flash

**What belongs here.** A short burst of bright exposure with bloom.

**Examples.** white flash, camera flash

**Family test.** Does the frame get brighter, glowing or flared at the cut, with an optical (not flat) quality?

Each transition here has its own folder named by its id (lowercase, hyphens). See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../../../CONTRIBUTING.md).

## Transitions

| Transition | Summary |
|---|---|
| [Flash](flash/) | A burst of overexposed light blows out the old scene and settles on the new one. |
